strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: The headless loop can explicitly run the product-continuation task admitted by M57.1 through existing Rust task.run authority without caller-side RPC switching.
The explicit loop can advance from a product continuation route into the next bounded task execution while preserving task.run as the execution boundary.
Rust denies missing authorization, stale progress, stale admission evidence, mismatched task/run/source decision identity, and stale product-continuation provenance before TaskRunning.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with supporting agent_loop and runtime_permission_enforcement.
answers.new_capability: headless.continue_once can consume an explicitly authorized product_continuation_run_target and run the M57.1 admitted continuation task through existing task.run authority exactly once, returning bounded task_run_result evidence.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M57.1 stops at admission and direct task.run requires caller-side route glue outside the headless continuation loop.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Brownie can admit the next product-continuation task but cannot execute it through the same replay-safe headless continuation route.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M57.1 admission, M12.4 Mode Pack policy binding, and M56.6 objective completion acceptance; it is the execution half of the product-continuation bridge.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The implementation extends the existing headless.continue_once parameter/result envelope and adds no JSON-RPC method.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It adds no report, digest, history, readiness, verdict, preview, dashboard, or inspection surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The runtime adds an execution-capable headless route that validates current progress, admission evidence, task/run identity, source decision fingerprints, and product-continuation provenance before delegating to task.run.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Scheduled callers can deterministically continue from product decision to admitted task to explicit execution without switching RPCs or owning policy.
answers.milestone_progress: Completes the M57 bridge if review confirms no further distinct continuation gap remains.

exit_criteria: headless.continue_once accepts bounded product_continuation_run_target evidence with explicit authorization and continuation_id

the route rejects stale progress, missing admission evidence, mismatched continuation task/run, source task/run, source decision, decision fingerprint, product evidence fingerprint, wrong route kind, and stale provenance before TaskRunning
the route delegates to existing task.run exactly once for the selected M57.1 admitted Created product-continuation task
exact replay returns the bounded task_run_result without duplicate TaskRunning or HeadlessContinuationDecisionRecorded evidence
no new JSON-RPC method, report, digest, history, readiness, verdict, preview, inspection, dashboard, provider expansion, workspace mutation expansion, or VSIX-owned policy is introduced

ledger and RPC outputs exclude raw prompts, provider responses, file content, diffs, stdout/stderr, commands, environment values, raw requests, raw ledger payloads, absolute paths, canonical paths, tokens, and secrets

delegates only to existing task.run authority and does not bypass product-continuation run freshness checks
stores bounded identifiers and SHA-256 fingerprints only
does not add a new RPC or wrapper surface
non_goals: no provider, tool, verifier, shell, git, network, service, scheduler, or daemon expansion beyond existing task.run

adding a product continuation readiness or inspection report
